1. Exposure: Pesticides, even when used according to label instructions, can be toxic to pollinators. Exposure to pesticides can reduce the survival, reproduction, and foraging behavior of both adults and larvae of pollinators.

2. Sublethal effects: Sublethal effects of pesticides can impair the foraging and learning behavior of pollinators, leading to reduced pollination efficiency.
